Percussionist Warren Smith has expertly balanced a successful career as a music educator, studio musician, and performing artist. Warren was active in the 1970s Soho loft scene and cites his participation in M’Boom with Max Roach as one of his most creative accomplishments.
Warren was interviewed in Utica, NY on March 17, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have with me, in Utica, New York at the Other Side, Warren Smith. And I’m going to start out with an understatement. Warren Smith has done a few diverse things in his career. Is that a fairly true statement?
That’s true. I like to keep it a round robin you know.
Uh huh. Has there been one thing out of all the things you’ve done that has been your favorite?
I would have to say two or three rather.
Okay. You can have two or three.
